info.about: Astro Boy: Omega Factor is a beat 'em up video game developed by Treasure and Hitmaker, and published by Sega. The game was released for the Game Boy Advance on December 18, 2003 in Japan; August 17, 2004 in North America; and February 18, 2005 in Europe.
info.why: A licensed Treasure title from 2004 that has never been re-released in any form, so the cartridge is the only way to own it.
